verdict.rationale: AutoGen's core AgentChat framework is built around agents that converse in natural language, and the UserProxyAgent lets a human provide natural-language feedback within a team run (autogen-docs-1, autogen-docs-3). However, configuring or operating the product itself (installing, building teams, running AutoGen Studio) is done via Python code or JSON/drag-and-drop, not natural-language commands to the product (autogen-docs-4, autogen-gh-1). Missing for 10: evidence of a dedicated natural-language command interface/CLI for controlling the framework itself, and independent confirmation that end-users (not agents) issue commands in plain language to operate the system.
